title: Monkey waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 72 Q14 70 16 56 Q18 46 26 48' fill='none' stroke='#b06a2c' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='70' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#c97b35'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='73' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#f0b877'/>
  <!-- left arm waving up -->
  <path d='M34 62 Q22 54 20 40' fill='none' stroke='#c97b35' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving hand -->
  <circle cx='19' cy='36' r='8' fill='#e8a35a'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='31' r='3' fill='#f0b877'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='28' r='3' fill='#f0b877'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='33' r='3' fill='#f0b877'/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <path d='M62 64 Q74 68 78 74' fill='none' stroke='#c97b35' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='76' r='7' fill='#e8a35a'/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='88' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#a85f26'/>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='88' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#a85f26'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='36' r='8' fill='#c97b35'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='36' r='4.5' fill='#f0b877'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='34' r='8' fill='#c97b35'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='34' r='4.5' fill='#f0b877'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='34' r='19' fill='#c97b35'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='38' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#f0b877'/>
  <!-- hair tuft -->
  <path d='M42 16 Q46 10 50 15 Q54 9 56 17' fill='none' stroke='#a85f26' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='32' r='4' fill='#3a2414'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='32' r='4' fill='#3a2414'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='30.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffe9c9'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='30.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffe9c9'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='40' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#8a4a1e'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 46 Q48 51 54 46' fill='none' stroke='#8a4a1e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
